name: KARTHIK BIBIREDDY
headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Distributed Systems & Data Infrastructure | Agentic AI Workflows
professionalSummary: Senior software engineer with 9+ years building distributed streaming and batch systems at Amazon and startups. I own high-scale customer-facing services on AWS, lead multi-region migrations and system design, tune event-driven pipelines, and drive team-wide adoption of agentic AI workflows.

workExperience.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
description: Sole owner of a zero-downtime, multi-region infrastructure migration for a customer-facing list-price validation service built as a hybrid of event-driven and streaming pipelines. Rebuilt the full IaC stack with AWS CDK, reduced NAT egress by roughly 90% (from 470GB to 6GB) using VPC endpoints, and lowered capacity concentration risk while maintaining 99.9% data accuracy and zero downtime on a service that processes 200M+ records per day worldwide and serves approximately 8M QPS across Amazon domains.

Built various AI-first apps used across Amazon, including Text Forge (~100 DAU, ~550 LLM-backed transforms/day) for one-click text cleanup and transformations, Chart Forge for converting plain-text and tabular data into time-series charts, and an AI ticket-labeling tool for semantic classification with trend analytics, adopted by Pricing Support teams as an early-warning signal for systemic issues. Also architected multi-stage on-call triage that has processed ~5,000 tickets in 10 months and cut initial triage time by 30%.

Designed a unified configuration platform so pricing teams can manage business rules in one place instead of across code, batch jobs, and separate config stores. I owned the full architecture, including the data model and a novel versioning and cascade mechanism that lets program managers simulate and test configuration changes before production rollout. This centralization reduces configuration errors and review time by enabling safe previews before changes go live.

Own Spark, EMR, and Scala batch pipelines and real-time streaming systems that power List Price, Typical Price, Lowest in 30 Days pricing, and Alexa Shopping price history for customers worldwide. Day to day, I evolve computation and validation logic end to end across 300M+ products, including updates for regional rules and compliance.

On Alexa Automotive, I delivered conversational car control and Teachable AI so customers can personalize voice commands (for example, 'I am hot' or 'set temperature to cozy'). I served as SME for the offline embedded car-control skill, improved prompt quality, and built target-device resolution using a scoring and reranking layer on top of Clucene. With a partner team, I shipped C++ messaging middleware that syncs SMS and WhatsApp messages to the in-car HUD. These features launched with major OEMs including Lamborghini, Stellantis, Lucid, and Rivian.

Implemented critical airliner systems components (Landing Gear software, Video Controller, Vehicle State Manager) to improve reliability and maintainability.
